note: Single-field bare-scalar acceptance (ADR 0067). PizzaName, ToppingName, ToppingAmount, CustomerName, Price and Size each declare exactly one attribute, so a bare scalar wraps into that sole field on both runtimes, both at the top level of a command argument and nested inside the multi-field Pizza value object. The counterpart refusal for a multi-field value object is pinned by refusal_wording_value_object_shape.json. A runtime that stops accepting the bare form for a single-field value object fails this fixture.
